# pvescheduler Provider

Schedules Proxmox VMs onto the least-loaded node. Falls back to PROXMOX_VE_ENDPOINT and PROXMOX_VE_API_TOKEN env vars if attributes are omitted.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) PVE API token in the form user@realm!tokenid=secret. Falls back to PROXMOX_VE_API_TOKEN.
- `endpoint` (String) PVE API endpoint, e.g. https://pve.example.com:8006. Falls back to PROXMOX_VE_ENDPOINT.
- `insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Falls back to PROXMOX_VE_INSECURE=true.
- `nodes` (List of String) Global allowlist of PVE node names eligible for scheduling. If ommitted, all online nodes are considered.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) PVE API password. Used with `username`. Falls back to PROXMOX_VE_PASSWORD
- `username` (String) PVE API username in the form user@realm. Falls back to PROXMOX_VE_USERNAME.
